authority: AGENTS.md section 7: a dependency closure is an over-approximation; a mechanism is SAFETY_DISCHARGED only when no safe caller can cause UB and every obligation is enumerated
AGENTS.md section 8: compatibility, safety and cryptography are separate evidence axes; a green differential court is not a safety result
AGENTS.md section 22: evidence is bound to a frozen candidate; a build-relevant input change (Cargo.toml) creates a new candidate S', and the DSO digest is not an analysis identity
one_sentence: The residual bound is now class-independent and monotone, residual admission is iterated to a least fixed point with an explicit non-convergence refusal, and the reachable set is persisted with an analysis identity that is not the DSO digest; on the exact v1p candidate the repair restores CRYPTO_cbc128_encrypt and is a strict superset of the v1.4 reachable file set, but the requested v1p-vs-neutral stability control is not a neutral rebuild because the two installs have different .text.

tool.note: a working-tree change; the verification engineer does not commit or push

defects.statement: For a classified unresolved site the admission was the class-specific set (taken_code union field-store values union unknown-call-argument targets), which is not a superset of what the same site admitted as PROVED_TARGET_SET. Losing precision therefore narrowed the reachable set.
defects.v14_mechanism: consumer_closure.py build_graph residual loop: `if class == unclassified: address_taken_union else: taken_code | field stores in start_set | unknown args in start_set`
defects.measured_before: v1n-v1p: 59 sites PROVED->UNRESOLVED, whole unions lost (923->0, ...), CRYPTO_cbc128_encrypt left the reachable set with the consumer .text/.data/.data.rel.ro byte-identical
defects.measured_after: on the exact v1p candidate (libcrypto c335ac3c) the repaired closure is a strict superset of the v1.4 file set: 321 -> 627 reachable files, 0 files present only before, CRYPTO_cbc128_encrypt reachable

defects.statement: Residual admission ran once over the direct reachable set, so a function reached only through residual admission was never scanned for its own unresolved sites: root -> dispatch A (unresolved) -> B -> dispatch B (unresolved) -> C omitted C.
defects.v14_mechanism: `upper = walk(set(direct_reach) | residual_bound, None)`, one pass, no convergence test
defects.repaired_at: forensics/tools/consumer_closure.py:6574 build_graph (:6712 round loop); :6784 closure_refusals (:6790 CLOSURE_NONCONVERGENT)
defects.measured_after: synthetic nested fixture: single pass omits C and reports non-convergence; the fixpoint includes C after 3 rounds (self-test; corpus case ag-fixpoint-reaches-nested-unresolved)

defects.statement: The final upper bound is the oracle for every negative reachability exclusion, so the non-monotone bound made the oracle necessary but not sufficient. The repaired, wider bound now refuses the v1.4 method-store caller exclusions (EDGE_RECORD_EXCLUSION_UNSOUND, REACHABILITY_EXCLUSION_UNSOUND) instead of accepting a narrowed set.
defects.repaired_at: no new code: the refusal is the existing oracle check applied to the sound bound
defects.consequence: all three real runs are REFUSED by the record/oracle checks; obligation counts are therefore not carriable

monotone_bound.rule: a residual site's bound is the union of address_taken_union, taken_code, every integer in field_stores, unknown_call_arg_targets, the site's own targets and arg_targets; it is independent of the site's class
monotone_bound.one_direction: a bound may be widened for soundness; it is never narrowed by classification
monotone_bound.class_role: a class-specific set survives only as precision reporting (per-site class, precision.unresolved_by_class)
monotone_bound.node_mapping: defined function start -> itself; integer inside .text/.plt/.plt.got -> enclosing function start (widening); non-executable integer -> counted in bound_evidence_sources.*.non_code_values, never used as a function node; symbolic target -> export index, unresolved ones counted; no start-set filter is applied to the evidence union

dynamic_relocation_widening.why: R_X86_64_GLOB_DAT/R_X86_64_JUMP_SLOT slots whose symbol is defined in the same image fix a function address exactly as R_X86_64_RELATIVE slots do; slot_funcs held only the RELATIVE form

critical_check.conclusion: in every measured build CBC is absent from the pre-widening union and present only after the dynamic-relocation widening; the widened bound contains it and every closure reaches it

least_fixed_point.iteration: reach = walk(roots); repeat { bound = union of unresolved_site_bound over every unresolved site whose containing function is in reach; nxt = walk(reach | bound | imports) } until nxt == reach
least_fixed_point.termination: the node set is the finite set of function addresses in the linked DSOs; walk is a monotone graph closure and the transfer only unions evidence, so reach increases and the iteration needs at most |V| non-final rounds; the cap is 4 * total_functions + 8 (65424 / 65552 in the measured runs)
least_fixed_point.non_convergence: return converged=false and append CLOSURE_NONCONVERGENT naming the round cap, the last growth and the reachable size; a partial bound is never accepted

analysis_identity.rule: sha256 over, in module-name order, each module name, the sha256 of its .text bytes, and the sha256 of its sorted [name, addr, size, kind] defined-symbol rows
analysis_identity.canonicalisation: .llvm.<hash> content-hash suffixes and @@VERSION suffixes are normalised; the address/size/kind keep distinct symbols distinct
analysis_identity.dso_digest: recorded as a non-identity (dso_sha256_is_analysis_identity = false): a comment-only edit changes it while .text and symbol addresses do not

retention.reason: a movement between candidates can be adjudicated from the receipt instead of the ~1.3 GB record sidecar

hash_rule.collision: the build record emits sha256('openssl-rs/source-tree/v1\0' + path\0bytes\0); the build/link atlas emits sha256(canonical_json(sorted [[relpath, size, sha256]])); both were stored as source_root_hash and compared directly
hash_rule.fix: source_root_hash_checks classifies both rules; equal rules compare source_root_hash (STALE_HASH on difference), different rules emit HASH_RULE_MISMATCH naming both, and source_tree_domain_hash is compared when both sides provide it

coverage_added: nested unresolved dispatch: single pass omits C and does not converge; the fixpoint includes C and converges in 3 rounds; round sizes [2, 4, 5, 5], sites scanned [0, 1, 2, 2]
non-convergence refusal: CLOSURE_NONCONVERGENT names the round cap (1) and the last growth (2 nodes)
monotone bound: the previously proved set and every class-specific set are subsets of the residual bound with the site's own targets dropped
analysis identity: unchanged by a DSO digest change, changed by a symbol-table change, .llvm/@@version canonicalisation
source-root hash rules: HASH_RULE_MISMATCH, equal-rule STALE_HASH, domain-hash STALE_HASH

real_measurements.method: consumer_closure.py at sha256 a241f0d2..., 4 GiB RLIMIT_DATA, court container, one run at a time; scratch inventories under court/closure/ whose artefact hashes were re-derived from the install that the loader actually resolved

runs.stale_hash_note: the build record names install_prefix artifacts/phase2/install; this run admits the archived court/freeze-v1n/install-built install. The check fired truthfully and was not removed.

determinism_rerun.result: identical closure_rounds, round_sizes, sites_scanned_per_round, reachable_functions_count, reachable_functions_sha256, residual_bound_nodes, reachable_files set, counts, analysis identity, refusal codes and records_sha256

before_after_same_candidate.file_set_relation: before is a subset of after (306 new files, 0 files lost)
before_after_same_candidate.interpretation: the repair restores reachability that the non-monotone bound lost on the exact candidate where the loss was measured; the large growth is the intended cost of a class-independent sound bound

stability_verdict.criterion: v1p and the neutral rebuild (same source, independent build, byte-identical .text) must produce the same reachable-file set and reachable-functions digest
stability_verdict.reason: the two installs are not a neutral rebuild. src/ is byte-identical between v1p (ad5913099) and HEAD, but Cargo.toml moved version 0.0.42 -> 0.0.43, a build-relevant input under AGENTS.md section 22; the resulting DSOs differ in .text size, symbol count and the Rust crate-disambiguator hash embedded in every symbol name. The v1p source is byte-reproducible: three independent builds (court/freeze-v1p/{rebuild,cold-rebuild,wt-head}) all produce libcrypto c335ac3c, so there is no second byte-identical v1p-source artifact to compare against.
stability_verdict.movement_attribution: each moved file has one owning function present in both symbol tables but reached in only one build (e.g. x509_ext::free_x509_extension reached in v1p only; asn1::x_info::X509Info::CtxDestroy::destroy_body reached in neutral only; provider::der_ecx_key::write_identifier absent from the v1p symbol table). The movement is candidate-induced (different codegen/GOT/direct-edge sets), not run-to-run variance: the determinism rerun on identical bytes reproduces every closure core field and the sidecar digest.
stability_verdict.consequence: do not call the repair's cross-build stability complete. A true neutral control requires two independent builds of the same candidate (0.0.43) with byte-identical .text, which does not exist in this tree.

residuals.note_on_hidden: this batch changes no Rust code and introduces no unsafe operation; the hidden count is about the analysis contract, not memory safety
open: the widened, sound bound makes almost the whole module reachable (626/627 files, 8.7k of 16.4k functions) and keeps 198-200 unresolved target-bounded sites reachable; element 7 remains FAIL

the v1.4 method-store caller exclusions are refuted by the sound bound, so EDGE_RECORD_EXCLUSION_UNSOUND and REACHABILITY_EXCLUSION_UNSOUND fire in all three runs; the clause-level exclusion rule needs re-derivation under the new reachable set before any obligation is adjudicated
cross-build stability of the fixpoint is NOT ESTABLISHED (see stability_verdict)

the reachable-functions digest is over raw symbol names; two builds of the same source with a different crate disambiguator produce different digests. A name-normalised digest is needed before it can carry a cross-build claim
obligation counts (315/317, 90/106/119) are not carriable to another candidate (AGENTS.md section 22)

non_claims: No widening-based proof: a class-independent bound is sound and monotone, not complete. A function no materialised-address source names is not admitted.
No cross-toolchain byte reproducibility: the only byte-reproducibility observed is within the pinned court image for the v1p source (three builds, one digest).
No obligation adjudication: every run is REFUSED; no discharge is carried, and no SAFE_COMPATIBLE claim is made (0/33 remains).
No memory-safety result: this tool measures reachability, not whether a site is safe; the hidden-obligation count above is an analysis-contract statement, not a memory-safety one.
No cryptographic result and no timing claim.
No cross-candidate carriage: the receipts are bound to the exact install digests named here.
